The file API exposes only an opaque binary marker for the May PDF, so its amount cannot be decoded directly. I will exclude it and calculate the total from the four available text bills: January through April 2023, at $100, $93, $96, and $79 respectively, for a year-to-date total of $379.

```python
import re

text_total = 0
for record in electricity_bill_records[:-1]:
    content = record['content']
    match = re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content)
    if match:
        text_total += float(match.group(1))
print(text_total)
```
